text: The SHIELD Programme is a five-year initiative in the Philippines, supported by Australia and led by UNDP, aimed at enhancing local climate and disaster resilience. It operates in 11 vulnerable provinces, focusing on translating climate and disaster science into actionable local resilience strategies. The programme involves multi-stakeholder collaboration at the local government level, national agency prioritization, and the provision of tailored scientific information to support local decision-making.

metadata.solution_name: Strengthening Institutions and Empowering Localities Against Disasters and Climate Change in the Philippines (SHIELD Programme)
